content.text: Should be auth.secret. Quick check of the signing side.

candidates.explanation: JwtStrategy verifies access tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret'. AuthService signs access tokens with 'auth.secret' (auth.service.ts:619) and signs refresh tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret'. The signature check therefore fails for every fresh access token, and passport answers 401. Login and refresh still work because they don't verify an access token.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret, 'auth.secret', in JwtStrategy's secretOrKey instead of 'auth.refreshSecret'.
